additional_info.subject: ID0479846-DC/Si-D/TR- [Y2/S3 300000004050] 2nd Socket Error Issue CRM:00263000471
additional_info.body:
Hi Irem, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the sessions for DC2 for the past 4 weeks and here are my findings:
1. Particular session ends:
1.a - On the 6th February the EV stopped charging without any explanation, during charging phase we expect a Pilot State C, and it changed to B on its own:
1.b - On the 2nd February a EV didn't proceed to start the charging process even though the charger was completely ready:
1.c - another occasion exactly like 1.a:
All the others sessions fail, I see that it's during authentication, either the user didn't authenticate the correct outlet or didn't authenticate at all.
In total from the past 4 weeks, 13 authentication failures and 42 successfull sessions.
The error in DC2 was due to a communication error between the charging controller and the main controller. I restarted it and it's working again.
Please let me know your feedback.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
